question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH best_drivers AS (
    SELECT 
        tdr.year,
        tdr.constructor_id,
        tdr.constructor_ref,
        tdr.driver_id,
        tdr.driver_ref,
        CAST(decode(tdr.team_driver_rank, 'hex') AS INTEGER) as team_driver_rank
    FROM team_driver_ranks tdr
    WHERE CAST(decode(tdr.team_driver_rank, 'hex') AS INTEGER) = 1
),
constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE cs.race_id IN (SELECT MAX(r2.race_id) FROM races r2 GROUP BY r2.year)
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
driver_season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        ds.driver_id,
        SUM(ds.points) as driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE ds.race_id IN (SELECT MAX(r2.race_id) FROM races r2 GROUP BY r2.year)
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        bd.year,
        c.name as constructor_name,
        bd.constructor_ref,
        bd.driver_ref as best_driver,
        csp.constructor_points,
        dsp.driver_points,
        csp.constructor_points + dsp.driver_points as combined_points
    FROM best_drivers bd
    JOIN constructor_season_points csp ON bd.constructor_id = csp.constructor_id AND bd.year = csp.year
    JOIN driver_season_points dsp ON bd.driver_id = dsp.driver_id AND bd.year = dsp.year
    JOIN constructors c ON bd.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
